# TUM-VI baseline: shipped estimator against the never-moving floor (generated by `python tools/tumvi_table.py`; do not edit by hand)

Estimator: `main.py` at da14417 (unchanged shipped settings). Floor: `tools/baseline_still.py` (one identity pose per row at the origin), scored the same way. APE = RMSE after SE3 Umeyama fitted on the run being scored. RPE 1 s = relative translation error over 200 frames. Gap = mean RMSE inside missing-row bursts (>= 5 rows). Blind = RMSE over the last 5 s (exact zeros). Official copies: the organisers' `degrade_imu.py` via `tools/official_degrade.py` (`--root data/tumvi`, seeds 1..3 evaluated here; seeds 1..3 and 7..15 exist on disk under `data/official_tumvi/`; seeds 7..9 are spent, seeds 10..15 are reserved for Claude Code's two judging rules, and seeds 16..18 are not generated and reserved for Claude Code). Tuning rooms: `room1`, `room2`; held out: `room3..room6` (`BG_MAX = 0.15 rad/s`).
